name: resize-for-web
summary: Downsize for the web, sharpen after resizing, convert to sRGB.
photoshop: Image > Image Size (Bicubic Sharper), Filter > Sharpen > Unsharp Mask, Edit > Convert to Profile sRGB, File > Export > Export As
notes: Sharpen once, after the final resize. Amount 40 to 80 %, radius 0.3 to 0.8 px for screens.
